Architecture Patterns.name: Event-Driven Microservices
Architecture Patterns.description: Decouples services using asynchronous event streams.

Architecture Patterns.name: Strangler Fig Pattern
Architecture Patterns.description: Incrementally migrates a legacy system by gradually replacing specific pieces of functionality with new applications and services.

Workflow Patterns.name: Parallel Approval Chain
Workflow Patterns.description: Executes approvals concurrently rather than sequentially to reduce cycle time.

Integration Patterns.name: Anti-Corruption Layer
Integration Patterns.description: Implements a facade or adapter layer between different subsystems that don't share the same semantics.

Security Patterns.name: Zero Trust Network Access
Security Patterns.description: Never trust, always verify. Enforces strict identity verification for every person and device trying to access resources.
